findings.title: CircuitBreaker.call() Method is Async-Only
findings.problem: The design assumes CircuitBreaker.call() handles both sync and async functions via executor wrapper. The actual implementation ONLY supports async. Sync functions in the else branch run synchronously in async context, blocking the event loop.
findings.impact: Enrichment service will block event loop when calling sync NASA POWER API, causing request timeouts under load.
findings.fix: Change CircuitBreaker.call() to detect sync functions and wrap them in executor internally using asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(). Update design Finding 2 resolution to call await breaker.call() directly without lambda wrapper.

findings.title: Feature Flag Fields Already Exist
findings.problem: Design instructs to add ENRICHMENT_* fields after line 123, but feature flags already exist at lines 109-112. Line 123 is inside Settings class. Adding duplicate fields will cause Pydantic field name collision errors at import time.
findings.impact: API startup failure with ValidationError when config.py is imported.
findings.fix: Add enrichment flags after existing feature flags (after line 112, before line 114) using same boolean parsing pattern as existing flags. Update Finding 5 resolution to specify correct line number.

findings.title: CircuitBreakerRegistry Conflicts with Existing Pattern
findings.problem: Design proposes migrating module-level breakers (supabase_breaker, model_breaker) to registry. But existing code attaches breakers to request.app.state in middleware. Services access breakers via request.app.state.supabase_breaker. Changing to registry breaks all existing references.
findings.impact: Services fail with AttributeError when accessing request.app.state.supabase_breaker after registry migration.
findings.fix: Keep existing module-level breakers for backward compatibility. Add registry as optional enhancement for NEW breakers only. Use registry for enrichment breakers (nasa_power, gbif_prey) but preserve supabase_breaker and model_breaker globals.

findings.title: SQL Migrations Directory Does Not Exist
findings.problem: Design references backend/sql/migrations/ directory with 5 migration files (000-004). PowerShell check confirms directory does not exist. No migration execution infrastructure exists.
findings.impact: Phase 4 cannot execute without manual directory creation. No automation for tracking applied migrations or verification.
findings.fix: Create backend/sql/migrations directory in Phase 1. Add migration executor script apply_migrations.py that prompts user to copy SQL to Supabase Editor (since Python client doesn't support raw SQL). Update Finding 8 resolution to include directory creation step.

findings.title: Exception Handler Integration Uses Wrong ErrorResponse Structure
findings.location: Design Finding 6 resolution, backend/api/main.py after line 73
findings.problem: Design exception handler code is structurally correct but missing explicit status field (defaults to 'error'). Actual ErrorResponse schema has status, error, timestamp, request_id, path fields. Design code omits status and timestamp.
findings.impact: Exception handler returns ErrorResponse without explicit status='error', relies on default. Timestamp field auto-populated but not explicitly set, may cause inconsistent response structure.
findings.fix: Update Finding 6 resolution to include explicit status='error' and timestamp=datetime.utcnow() fields in ErrorResponse construction.

findings.title: Import Path Changes Break Existing Services
findings.location: Design Finding 11 resolution, Section 1 (Directory Structure Reorganization)
findings.problem: Design proposes moving scripts to subdirectories (backend/scripts/data_enrichment/fetch_rainfall_nasa.py) and updating imports. But backend/services/ecological_data_service.py line 19 imports from scripts.fetch_rainfall_nasa at module load time. If scripts are moved without updating imports atomically, service will fail to import, breaking API startup.
findings.impact: API fails to start with ImportError after script reorganization if imports are not updated before first import attempt.
findings.fix: Add import update verification step to Finding 11 resolution. Run py_compile on each service after moving scripts. Add Phase 1 verification checklist item to test API startup after script reorganization.

findings.title: enrich_cells_with_live_data Signature Change Breaks Callers
findings.problem: Design changes signature to add request: Request = None parameter. Function is called in backend/api/routes.py line 125 without request parameter. With None default, call succeeds but fails at runtime when accessing request.app.state.feature_flags (None.app raises AttributeError).
findings.impact: Runtime failure in enrichment service when called from routes without request parameter. Silent failure during testing if feature flags are not accessed.
findings.fix: Add null check in enrich_cells_with_live_data to use default flags when request is None. Update all callers in routes.py to pass request parameter. Add to Finding 1 resolution and Phase 2 checklist.

findings.title: Study Area Bounds Loading Lacks Error Recovery
findings.location: Design Finding 10 resolution, backend/core/config.py Settings class
findings.problem: Design adds async get_study_area_bounds() method to Settings class. But Settings is instantiated at module load time (line 168), and method requires database connection. If called during startup before Supabase is initialized, it will fail.
findings.impact: Study area bounds cannot be loaded at Settings instantiation time. Method will fail if called before lazy_init() completes in main.py.
findings.fix: Move bounds loading to lazy initialization in main.py lazy_init() function. Store in _state['study_area_bounds']. Attach to request.app.state in init_middleware. Update Finding 10 resolution to remove async method from Settings.

findings.title: BBoxRequest Validation Missing min < max Check
findings.problem: Design adds validation note for antimeridian but does not validate that min_lon < max_lon and min_lat < max_lat. Invalid bounding boxes like min_lon=35, max_lon=34 will pass validation but cause PostGIS queries to return empty results.
findings.impact: Invalid bounding boxes accepted by API, causing confusing empty result sets without error messages.
findings.fix: Add Pydantic @model_validator to BBoxRequest that checks min_lon < max_lon and min_lat < max_lat. Raise ValueError with descriptive message if validation fails.

findings.title: Migration 000 SRID Repair Assumes ST_SetSRID is Safe
findings.problem: Migration uses ST_SetSRID(geom, 4326) to fix SRID. ST_SetSRID changes SRID metadata without transforming coordinates. If existing geometries are actually in different CRS (e.g., UTM), this creates data corruption where coordinates are interpreted as WGS84 but are actually projected coordinates.
findings.impact: Silent data corruption if geometries are not actually in WGS84. Maps will show features in wrong locations (e.g., Kenya features appearing in ocean if coordinates are UTM meters).
findings.fix: Add validation step BEFORE repair to check if coordinates are within plausible WGS84 bounds. Use ST_Transform if current SRID is known (e.g., 32736 for UTM 36S). Only use ST_SetSRID for SRID 0 (unknown) after validating coordinate bounds.

findings.title: Hardcoded Color Search Excludes TypeScript Config Files
findings.problem: Search pattern excludes .next, node_modules but not other generated directories. Also misses TypeScript declaration files (*.d.ts), test files (*.test.ts, *.spec.tsx), and Storybook stories (*.stories.tsx) that may contain hardcoded colors.
findings.impact: Incomplete color audit leaves hardcoded colors in test files and type declarations, causing inconsistent styling in development/testing environments.
findings.fix: Broaden search to include all TypeScript sources, then filter out test files and declarations manually. Add exclusions for coverage, *.test.*, *.spec.* patterns.

findings.title: Response Schema Backward Compatibility Test is Incomplete
findings.problem: Design proposes capturing baseline response and comparing with diff. This catches structural changes but not field order changes (JSON objects are unordered), floating point precision changes, timestamp format changes, or null vs missing field differences.
findings.impact: False positives in diff comparison cause unnecessary investigation. False negatives miss breaking changes like field removal or type changes.
findings.fix: Use JSON schema validation instead of plain diff. Generate schema from baseline response, validate new response against schema. Check field presence with Python script that ignores field order.

findings.title: Performance Baselines Have No Measurement Automation
findings.problem: Design states baselines are estimates and must be measured in staging. Provides manual procedure but no automation script. Manual measurement is error-prone and non-repeatable.
findings.impact: Performance regression testing cannot be automated. Baseline measurements vary between testers, causing inconsistent regression detection.
findings.fix: Create performance baseline measurement script backend/scripts/validation/measure_performance_baselines.py that runs queries 10 times, calculates median and p95, and saves to docs/performance_baselines.json.

findings.title: Code Simplification Has No Refactoring Safety Net
findings.problem: Acceptance criteria for enrich_cells_with_live_data refactoring state 'write tests BEFORE refactoring' but provides no guidance on HOW to write tests for async service with external API dependencies.
findings.impact: Refactoring proceeds without tests, introduces regressions. Or test writing stalls due to lack of concrete examples, blocking refactoring.
findings.fix: Add concrete test template to Finding 20 resolution showing how to mock FastAPI Request, feature flags, and external API calls (NASA, GBIF) using pytest-asyncio and unittest.mock.

recommendations: Resolve all HIGH findings before implementation begins
Create detailed rollback plan for SQL migrations and import path changes
Set up staging environment to test migrations before production
Write integration tests covering circuit breaker failure scenarios
Follow phase sequence strictly - do not skip phases
Monitor circuit breaker state via /admin/circuit-breakers endpoint
Measure actual performance baselines in staging environment
Document API breaking changes in CHANGELOG.md
